install_startup.recipe_modification_note: The repo has no Dockerfile/compose file (docs live on the project website, not in-repo). The documented Docker Hub image (onedev/server) no longer exists there ('object not found') - the project's org moved to 1dev/server on Docker Hub at some point; used that instead, same official image, just a renamed org. Single container, ports 6610 (HTTP) and 6611 (SSH). The server's own first-run wizard (admin account creation, then a Server URL confirmation step) was completed with the pipeline's standard libwalker/Walker-Pass-2026! test credentials. The generic screen crawler couldn't drive this app's own login/setup flow: unauthenticated visits to '/' show a Sign Up page rather than a login form (self-registration is enabled by default), and OneDev's real /login page submits via an in-place Wicket AJAX update rather than a normal navigation - the page left behind immediately after submit can still be a stale/broken view even once the session is genuinely authenticated, which the crawler reads as a failed login. Driven directly via a one-off Playwright script instead: login at /login, then a fresh navigation to '/' (not the AJAX-updated page) to land on the real authenticated dashboard, followed by a 7-screen walkthrough (Projects, Pull Requests, Issues, Builds, and Admin's Users/System Settings) captured with the exact same control-inventory/screenshot logic screens.py itself uses.
